# noozle_aws_sns_outlet (Resource)

Manages a Noozle AWS SNS outlet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

resource "noozle_aws_sns_outlet" "alerts" {
  name          = "AWS SNS alerts"
  enabled       = true
  topic_arn     = "arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:noozle-alerts"
  notify_policy = "FIRST_ONLY"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the outlet is active.
- `name` (String) Name presented for the outlet.
- `topic_arn` (String) AWS SNS topic ARN.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `credentials` (Block, Optional) Optional inline AWS credentials for this outlet. Values are write-only; rotate each credential by updating its value and incrementing the matching version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--credentials))
- `description` (String) Optional note explaining the outlet purpose.
- `endpoint_url` (String) AWS service endpoint URL for SNS.
- `expiry_window` (String) Expiry window for refreshed SNS credentials.
- `external_id` (String) External ID for assuming an AWS IAM role.
- `max_in_flight` (Number) Maximum number of in-flight SNS messages.
- `message_deduplication_id` (String) AWS FIFO message deduplication ID.
- `message_group_id` (String) AWS FIFO message group ID.
- `metadata_exclude_prefixes` (List of String) Metadata header prefixes to exclude from SNS messages.
- `notify_policy` (String) Delivery policy applied when notifying this outlet.
- `profile` (String) AWS shared credential profile name for SNS.
- `region` (String) AWS region for SNS.
- `role_arn` (String) AWS IAM role ARN to assume for SNS.
- `timeout` (String) Timeout for SNS publish requests.
- `use_ec2_instance_role` (Boolean) Use the EC2 instance role for SNS credentials.

### Read-Only

- `applied_generation` (Number) Last observed applied config generation.
- `apply_status` (String) Observed apply/runtime status for the outlet.
- `config_generation` (Number) Desired outlet config generation.
- `id` (Number) Unique identifier of the outlet.
- `last_apply_error` (String) Last observed apply/runtime error message.

- `session_token_version` (Number) Monotonic version used to rotate `session_token`.
